scope: Exact current selected upstream + explicit existing local adaptations/resources. No runtime, PM host persistence or source repository is copied wholesale.
patchFormat: integration-patches/*.json exact original-line splices with whole-file SHA256 preconditions and postconditions
verification: New-generation exact recipe authoring only; integrated provenance/build/resource/behavior verification remains required.

runtimeResources.nativeResources: Complete installed production packages and available optional native dependencies; preserve original importer resolution, opaque SDK/SQLite/keyring edges, chunks/native/CLI siblings and all licenses. Target-specific packaging; no dependency install, Keychain read or external CLI redistribution.

effectSingleton.strategy: Build external; package graph canonicalizes Effect to one relative-linked artifact location and refuses another version or bundled Effect inputs.

runtimeResources.workspaceRoot: Preserve apps/server/agent/dist depth so ../../../../ resolves the artifact root, not the source repository.
runtimeResources.acceptance: Parent-only: relocated included tools/verify-artifact.mjs; no T18 execution.

extractions.adaptation: Exact original declaration with two local provenance/isolation comment lines; original root MIT notice retained.
Browser-safe annotation extraction with React/form rendering excluded; actual derived bytes and current imports are separately hashed.

modePolicy.creation: Canonical POSIX 0644 for non-executable files and 0755 for executable files; no special-mode bits.
modePolicy.existingDestination: Match content hash and Git-style executable class (any POSIX execute bit, mode & 0111). Ordinary read/write permission differences such as 0644 versus 0664 are retained untouched.
modePolicy.unsafeDestination: Reject setuid, setgid and sticky bits (mode & 07000) on regular files before any destination writes; symlinks and nonregular targets remain refused.
